title: Second-Brain Sync Failure Watch
dataSources: Highlights (`reading:highlight`), book activity (`reading:book`), reviews (`reading:review`), paper libraries (`research:paper`), sync states (`reading:sync`).
app: Reading and second-brain telemetry — Readwise review exports, Kindle highlights, Goodreads shelves, and Zotero research libraries — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reading:sync target_system=* sync_failed=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(sync_failed="yes",1,0))) as matched by target_system
| eval a_failed_sync_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_failed_sync_pct
description: Measures the percentage of second-brain sync jobs that end with a failed sync by target system.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which target system are helping or hurting second-brain sync jobs.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a failed sync` on `reading:sync` events and summarize the hit rate by `target_system`.
visualization: Table of target system with percentage of second-brain sync jobs ending with a failed sync.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how often a failed sync happens for each target system so you can see where second-brain sync jobs go smoothly or get stuck.
